title: Rift valley mapped in the Mid-Atlantic Ridge
place: Lamont Geological Observatory, New York, USA
summary: Working from sonar soundings, Tharp mapped the Atlantic Ocean floor with Bruce Heezen and identified the rift along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.
why: Helped bring about acceptance of plate tectonics.

unsung.contribution: Mapped the Atlantic seafloor and found the rift valley along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.
unsung.recognition: Heezen at first dismissed her explanation as 'girl talk'; she was recognised mainly late in life.
